```{r global-options, include=FALSE}
# Code chunks are shown but not executed: the analysis needs the input files of the
# study, which are not part of this code repository. Set eval = TRUE (or run a chunk

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE)
```

# TWAS

This document merges every source file of the TWAS folder. Genetically predicted 
blood (GTEx v8 whole blood) and brain (GTEx v8 frontal cortex BA9) gene expression 
is tested for association with obstructive sleepapnea and with the five overnight 
oximetry traits, using the FUSION elastic net weights.

The shell scripts run FUSION.assoc_test.R chromosome by chromosome and the R scripts
merge the per-chromosome output, apply a Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction to TWAS.P
and keep the genes that reach FDR < 0.05.

## Notes on the merged code

* Each section below holds one source file of this folder, and the file name is given
  both in the section heading and in the first comment line of the chunk.
* Every path that pointed at the analysis tree of the original workstation is rewritten
  to a short relative path below the placeholder root `Path/`; `Path/datasource/` stands
  for the input data, `Path/R-4.3.1/bin/` for the R interpreter and
  `Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/` for the SMR executable. Point them at your own
  installation before running the code.
* The Chinese comments and chunk titles of the original scripts are given in English;
  the date of the original document header is not part of this merged file.
* Shell scripts are kept in their own `bash` chunks.

---

## `TWAS_AHI_code.txt`

```{bash "TWAS_AHI_code.txt", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: TWAS_AHI_code.txt (shell script)
# ===========================================================================
#blood gene TWAS
CHR=22
until [ $CHR -lt 1 ]
do
Path/R-4.3.1/bin/Rscript.exe Path/TWAS/Official_FUSION/fusion_twas-master/FUSION.assoc_test.R \
--sumstats Path/datasource/GWAS_data/AHI_TWAS_format.txt \
--weights Path/datasource/TWAS_weight/GTExv8.EUR.Whole_Blood.pos \
--weights_dir Path/datasource/TWAS_weight/ \
--ref_ld_chr Path/TWAS/Official_FUSION/LDref/1000G.EUR. \
--force_model enet \
--chr ${CHR} \
--out Path/TWAS/GTEx_TWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr${CHR}.out
let CHR-=1
done


#brain gene TWAS
CHR=22
until [ $CHR -lt 1 ]
do
Path/R-4.3.1/bin/Rscript.exe Path/TWAS/Official_FUSION/fusion_twas-master/FUSION.assoc_test.R \
--sumstats Path/datasource/GWAS_data/AHI_TWAS_format.txt \
--weights Path/datasource/TWAS_weight/GTExv8.EUR.Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9.pos \
--weights_dir Path/datasource/TWAS_weight/ \
--ref_ld_chr Path/TWAS/Official_FUSION/LDref/1000G.EUR. \
--force_model enet \
--chr ${CHR} \
--out Path/TWAS/GTExBrain_TWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr${CHR}.out
let CHR-=1
done
```

## `TWAS_AHI_Rcode.Rmd`

```{r "TWAS_AHI_Rcode.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: TWAS_AHI_Rcode.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(openxlsx)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(data.table)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Merge blood TWAS results and export
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
results <- tibble()
for (chr in 1:22) {
    results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/TWAS/GTEx_TWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr", chr, ".out")))
    if(chr==6){
        results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/TWAS/GTEx_TWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr6.out.MHC")))
    }
}
#FDR correction
results$TWAS.P.FDR<-NA
results_temp<-subset(results,results$TWAS.P!=0)
results<-results[-which(results$ID %in% results_temp$ID),]
results_temp$TWAS.P.FDR<-p.adjust(results_temp$TWAS.P,method = "fdr",n = length(results_temp$TWAS.P))
results<-rbind(results_temp,results)
write.xlsx(results,"Path/TWAS/BloodGene_AHI_TWAS.xlsx")

#Select the significant TWAS results
TWAS_res<-subset(results,results$TWAS.P.FDR<0.05)
write.xlsx(TWAS_res,"Path/TWAS/BloodGene_AHI_TWAS_Sig.xlsx")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Merge brain TWAS results and export
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
results <- tibble()
for (chr in 1:22) {
    results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/TWAS/GTExBrain_TWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr", chr, ".out")))
    if(chr==6){
        results <- rbind(results,read_tsv(paste0("Path/TWAS/GTExBrain_TWAS_by_chr/AHI_chr6.out.MHC")))
    }
}
results$ID_Gene<- substring(results$ID,17,)
#FDR correction
results$TWAS.P.FDR<-NA
results_temp<-subset(results,results$TWAS.P!=0)
results<-results[-which(results$ID %in% results_temp$ID),]
results_temp$TWAS.P.FDR<-p.adjust(results_temp$TWAS.P,method = "fdr",n = length(results_temp$TWAS.P))
results<-rbind(results_temp,results)
write.xlsx(results,"Path/TWAS/BrainGene_AHI_TWAS.xlsx")

#Select the significant TWAS results
TWAS_res<-subset(results,results$TWAS.P.FDR<0.05)
write.xlsx(TWAS_res,"Path/TWAS/BrainGene_AHI_TWAS_Sig.xlsx")
```

## `TWAS_SleepApnea_Rcode.Rmd`

```{r "TWAS_SleepApnea_Rcode.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: TWAS_SleepApnea_Rcode.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(openxlsx)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(data.table)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Merge blood TWAS results and export
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
results <- tibble()
for (chr in 1:22) {
    results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/TWAS/GTEx_TWAS_by_chr/SleepApnea_chr", chr, ".out")))
    if(chr==6){
        results <- rbind(results, read_tsv(paste0("Path/TWAS/GTEx_TWAS_by_chr/SleepApnea_chr6.out.MHC")))
    }
}
#FDR correction
results$TWAS.P.FDR<-NA
results_temp<-subset(results,results$TWAS.P!=0)
results<-results[-which(results$ID %in% results_temp$ID),]
results_temp$TWAS.P.FDR<-p.adjust(results_temp$TWAS.P,method = "fdr",n = length(results_temp$TWAS.P))
results<-rbind(results_temp,results)
write.xlsx(results,"Path/TWAS/BloodGene_SleepApnea_TWAS.xlsx")

#Select the significant TWAS results
TWAS_res<-subset(results,results$TWAS.P.FDR<0.05)
write.xlsx(TWAS_res,"Path/TWAS/BloodGene_SleepApnea_TWAS_Sig.xlsx")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Merge brain TWAS results and export

for (chr in 1:22) {

        results <- rbind(results,read_tsv(paste0("Path/TWAS/GTExBrain_TWAS_by_chr/SleepApnea_chr6.out.MHC")))
    }
}
results$ID_Gene<- substring(results$ID,17,)
#FDR correction

results<-results[-which(results$ID %in% results_temp$ID),]
results_temp$TWAS.P.FDR<-p.adjust(results_temp$TWAS.P,method = "fdr",n = length(results_temp$TWAS.P))
results<-rbind(results_temp,results)
write.xlsx(results,"Path/TWAS/BrainGene_SleepApnea_TWAS.xlsx")
```
